A _port_ for a worn Fluid Backtank, like a pump with a direction. Pipes connect to its _nozzle_.
block.bloodandbones.beheader.tooltip.beh: Takes the _head_ off in one stroke.
Zombies, skeletons, creepers and piglins sometimes leave their _skull_ whole. A wither skeleton's rarely survives.
On the top edge. A _spawn egg_ or a _carcass piece_ sets it to one kind of mob; a Create _filter_ works too. Empty, it takes anything.

block.bloodandbones.charging_cradle.tool: Swaps a full _Soul Canister_ into any brass minion beside it that is running low or has powered down, and keeps the empty. With _brass sheets_ it mends one docked there.
Full canisters and sheets go in, empties come out, by funnel, hopper, chute or _Mechanical Arm_. By hand: R-Click with a canister or sheet to put it in, with an empty hand to take the empties.
Where _brass minions_ get fresh soul blood. Needs a shaft from below turning at _16 RPM_ or more; the faster, the quicker the swap.
block.bloodandbones.deglover.tooltip.beh: Skins it a stroke at a time: _hide_ and, from a sheep, _wool_ into its output.

block.bloodandbones.deglover.tooltip.sum: Spiked rollers that strip the _hide_ off a carcass. Driven by a _shaft from below_.
block.bloodandbones.guillotine.tooltip.b: Takes the nearest _limb_ off in one stroke. It never takes the head.

block.bloodandbones.mangler.tooltip.beha: Tears the _limbs_ off, then grinds every piece into meat, bone, offal and fat.
Keeps what it makes _inside_: take it with an empty hand, or pull it out with a _funnel_, chute or hopper. When full, it stops.
On the top edge. A _spawn egg_ or a _carcass piece_ sets it to one kind of mob; a Create _filter_ works too. Empty, it takes anything.
block.bloodandbones.mangler.tooltip.summ: Teeth and rollers that tear a carcass _apart_ and grind it down. Driven by a _shaft from below_.
block.bloodandbones.ribcage_arch.tooltip: Faces you, so a stack built from inside the arch bends towards you. Placed against another rib, it _lines up_ with it.
A segment of _giant rib_, wet and bloody at the joints. Stacked, ribs rise straight; the top one _bends in_; ribs hung in the air beside it run level, the _crown_ of the arch.
block.bloodandbones.shackle_hook.tooltip: Hangs the carcass you are dragging by the _neck_, belly facing out, swinging. Click again to let it down.
A hung carcass never _settles_, can be worked from every side, and _bleeds_ into a Bleeding Rack below.

block.bloodandbones.spit_roast.tooltip.b: _Skewers_ it. It roasts only while the spit _turns_ and there is _heat_ below: a campfire, fire, lava or a Blaze Burner. Hotter and faster cooks quicker.

block.bloodandbones.surgery_table.toolti: Lays it on the table: a _Cleaver_ takes a limb off (a player's only with a _surgeon minion_ at the table), a _prosthetic_ or a _severed limb_ goes where one is missing.
You _lie down_ on it and choose which part to operate on. _Sneak_ to get up.
Takes back what lies on the table.
R-Click with an _empty hand_ to operate on them: another player, or a _mob_ you led onto it on a lead. What comes out is yours.

R-Click with a _Cleaver_ to take its _organs_ out, one a cut: a body's heart, lungs, stomach and the _special organ_ its mob has (a sac, a gland, a core), a head's eyes. With nothing laid on it, the Cleaver works on a _carcass lying over it_ that is too heavy to carry.

With an _Assembly Frame_ fitted, lay a carcass _torso_ on it (or R-Click with an empty hand to take a whole carcass lying on it), then R-Click with carcass _heads_, _legs_, _arms_ and _tails_ of any mob to stitch them on. A _Cleaver_ takes the last back off; a bucket of _blood_ wakes it.

bloodandbones.jei.backtank.1: The Fluid Backtank holds any fluid, worn in the chest slot with the armour of its tier: copper 2 buckets, gold 3, iron 4, diamond 6, blood steel 8, blood diamond 16, soul netherite 32.
bloodandbones.jei.backtank.2: Right-click a block to set it down; pipes fill or empty it from any side, and it keeps its fluid when broken. A Spout fills it and an Item Drain empties it in the hand. The soul netherite tank is a smithing upgrade of the blood diamond one.
bloodandbones.jei.backtank.3: Crafted with a carcass chestplate, it straps onto the chestplate's back, fluid and all: worn, it is your tank, and the chestplate has the better armour of the two. Craft the chestplate alone to take the tank off again.
bloodandbones.jei.bleeding_rack.1: Put a Bleeding Rack under a Shackle Hook (up to 8 blocks below) and hang a carcass: its blood drips into the tray. A carcass lying still on the rack drains too, more slowly.
bloodandbones.jei.bleeding_rack.2: A cow holds about a bucket. Encased Fans blowing across the body drain it up to four times faster. Pipe the blood out of the sides or bottom.
bloodandbones.jei.butchery.1: Bigger pieces give more: meat and bone come from every part by its size, offal and fat from the body.
bloodandbones.jei.butchery.2: Fresh meat is whole. Half-rotten meat gives half. Badly rotten meat turns to rotten flesh, and a rotten carcass has no hide worth taking. Cold slows rot, ice stops it, and a bled carcass keeps longer.
bloodandbones.jei.carcass_armour.1: Carcass armour is made of scraps from the Mangler. Five head scraps of one mob make a helmet, four leg scraps boots. A chestplate is six torso scraps with two arm scraps of any one mob on top (the shoulders); leggings are four leg scraps with three tail scraps of any one mob, or more legs, on top (the hips). A mob with no bone of a kind uses its torso scraps there.
bloodandbones.jei.carcass_armour.2: Craft a piece with one thing to fit it: hides of one mob (one for a helmet or boots, two for leggings, three for a chestplate) for its hide traits; an organ taken out of a mob on the Surgery Table (a heart, eyes, a Gland, a rabbit's foot: each says which pieces take it, eyes a helmet, a heart a chestplate) for its organ traits. What it replaces comes back.
bloodandbones.jei.carcass_armour.3: Tiers, in order: a Blood Steel Ingot, then a Blood Diamond, then a Soul Netherite Ingot, each giving more armour, toughness and durability than the last. Mechanical Crafters fit hides, organs and tiers too, but only where nothing comes back out.
bloodandbones.jei.cleaver.1: The Cleaver takes a carcass apart. Right-click a limb three times to cut through the joint; it comes free as a piece of its own that can be hooked, carried, hung or butchered.
bloodandbones.jei.cleaver.2: Three more cuts on a loose piece butcher it into meat and bone. The body is butchered last, once nothing hangs off it; it gives the offal and fat.
bloodandbones.jei.decoration.1: Bloody Casing: fill an Andesite Casing with 250 mB of blood from a Spout. It joins up with its neighbours like Create's own casings. Brass, Copper and Train Casings take blood the same way. So does Create's cut calcite, 100 mB a block: a small stained palette of cut, polished, bricks and small bricks, with stairs and slabs from the stonecutter.
bloodandbones.jei.decoration.2: Gut Chain: three pieces of offal in a column make three. It hangs and lies like a chain. Used on a Create chain conveyor's chain, it hangs a link from it that rides round with the chain; use more on the string to lengthen it, up to eight links, and hit it to take it down.
bloodandbones.jei.decoration.3: Ribcage Arch: build two stacks facing each other; the top of each bends inward, and ribs hung in the air between them run level to close the arch. A row of arches makes the inside of a ribcage. Bone Pile: use it on a pile to add a layer; each layer drops two bones.
bloodandbones.jei.display.1: Show off your work. The Butcher's Hook hangs on the side of a solid block and takes any body part: a carcass piece, a severed limb, an organ, scraps, meat or a head. The Specimen Jar sits anywhere and holds one thing, any thing. A carcass piece keeps in either. Right-click with it, and with an empty hand to take it back.
bloodandbones.jei.display.2: The Butcher's Table holds a piece too, lying on its top: right-click it with a Cleaver and it comes apart into meat, bone, offal and fat, spoiled as far as it had rotted.
bloodandbones.jei.flensing_knife.1: The Flensing Knife takes the hide off. Four strokes on any part of a carcass and the whole hide drops, with a sheep's wool, a mooshroom's mushrooms or a rabbit's pelt as it applies.
bloodandbones.jei.flensing_knife.2: Skin before you butcher: a piece cut down with its hide still on loses it. Rot spoils hides.
bloodandbones.jei.gland.1: Every mob has a special organ, some several: a creeper's powder sac, a cow's rumen, a blaze's core, a skeleton's marrow. Lay a carcass piece on a Surgery Table with its Surgical Rig and R-Click with a Cleaver: out come its organs, one a cut, each named for its mob. A carcass too heavy to carry gives them up lying over the table. Some bring more with them (a powder sac spills gunpowder).
bloodandbones.jei.gland.2: Fit one into a piece of carcass armour in a crafting grid (each says which pieces take it), or into a minion on the Assembly Frame. What it does there comes from its mob: the Body Parts page of each mob lists them.
bloodandbones.jei.implants.1: Basic prosthetics (Peg Leg, Hook Hand) need nothing. Organic ones (Flesh Arm, Sinew Leg, Furnace Stomach) run on blood and cybernetics (Hydraulic Arm, Piston Leg, Optic Eye, Pump Heart, Bellows Lungs) on soul blood, from a worn Fluid Backtank, a mB or two a second. The Vent Arm runs on whatever the tank holds; the Port Arm needs nothing.
bloodandbones.jei.implants.2: The gauge by the hotbar, where Create shows a backtank's air, reads the worn tank whenever one is on or a powered implant is fitted: how much it holds, a bar of the fluid itself, and under it the implants it runs, dimmed when their fuel is not in the tank.
bloodandbones.jei.implants.3: When the tank runs out of their fluid they stop working, as if the part were missing, until it is filled again. The Vent Arm sprays the tank (hold use, empty-handed); the Port Arm plugs the tank into pipes at a Backtank Port.
bloodandbones.jei.machines.1: The Mangler, Guillotine, Beheader and Deglover work any carcass lying on or hanging over them. Each takes a shaft from below; the faster it turns, the faster it works, but the Deglover no faster past 32 RPM, and the Guillotine only winds its blade up faster: a redstone pulse drops it. Set them flush in a floor so a body lies across them.
bloodandbones.jei.machines.2: Guillotine: limbs off. Beheader: heads off, sometimes a skull. Deglover: hides off. Mangler: everything, down to meat and bone. Take their output with a funnel or an empty hand.
bloodandbones.jei.machines.3: The filter slot on each machine's top edge picks what it works on: a spawn egg or a carcass piece for one kind of mob, or a Create list or attribute filter.
bloodandbones.jei.meat_hook.1: The Meat Hook is where a carcass comes from. Kill an animal or monster with it and the whole body stays behind as a ragdoll you can hook, drag, hang, cut up and process, instead of its loot.
bloodandbones.jei.meat_hook.2: Right-click a limb to hook it and drag the body behind you. Heavier animals slow you down more. Right-click again to let go. What the mob was carrying (saddles, chests, armour, held items) still drops.
bloodandbones.jei.minions.1: Fit an Assembly Frame to a Surgery Table and lay a carcass torso on it, or take a whole carcass lying on it with an empty hand (what is still attached comes along). Stitch on heads, legs, arms and tails of any mob, one a click: a cow on rabbit legs is a cow that hops. A Cleaver takes the last piece back. Wake it with a bucket of blood.
bloodandbones.jei.minions.2: Every part does its own thing. The torso sets its size, health and how much it carries; the head its sight, its bite and its knacks; the legs how fast and how it moves; arms its blows and what it holds with. Any minion can take any task, some far better than others. Crouch and R-Click it with an empty hand for its tasks: how well it does each and why, where it works and how far it reaches.
bloodandbones.jei.minions.3: It runs on blood: a little all the time, more moving, working and fighting. Low, it walks to a Blood Trough to drink. Empty, it lies down where it is, alive, and nothing but a player can hurt it; give it blood and it gets up. Crouch-R-Click one lying down a few times to fold it up and carry it; set down, it works from there. Its maker's Cleaver on one lying down on an Assembly Frame table takes it back apart into a frame there.
bloodandbones.jei.morgue.1: The Steel Table holds one item, any item, on its top. Tables side by side join into one run, with legs only where the run ends or turns. Funnels and hoppers can load it.
bloodandbones.jei.morgue.2: The Steel Rack has two shelves of two places. Right-click its front with an item on the place you are looking at; an empty hand takes it back. Funnels and hoppers fill it from the lower left.
bloodandbones.jei.shackle_hook.1: Mount the Shackle Hook under a ceiling or on a wall. Drag a carcass close and click the hook with the Meat Hook to hang it by the neck.
bloodandbones.jei.shackle_hook.2: To send a carcass down a line, drag it under a Create chain conveyor and right-click the chain with the Meat Hook: it rides the chain on a trolley, round wheels and along strands, and stops at frogports addressed for it.
bloodandbones.jei.soul_blood.1: Soul Blood is blood with a soul in it, and it takes a line of machines to make in bulk. First a Basin Lid on a Basin of blood sets 250 mB of it into Congealed Blood. Then an Encased Fan blowing through soul fire haunts it into a Soul Clot. Last, a Mechanical Mixer over a superheated Basin melts the clot back into 200 mB of Soul Blood.
bloodandbones.jei.soul_blood.2: There are two quicker ways, both far poorer: mix a bucket of blood with soul sand and 100 mB of liquid experience over a superheated Blaze Burner, or put nether wart and soul soil in with the blood under the Basin Lid. Each gives back only 100 mB. Nether mobs hung over a Bleeding Rack bleed a little Soul Blood straight away.
bloodandbones.jei.surgery.1: Amputation is a ritual: lay a Cleaver on the Surgery Table (with its Surgical Rig), have a minion with a hand awake beside it and set to Surgeon, and lie on the table (right-click with an empty hand) to have one of your own limbs, eyes or organs taken out. You get it back, with your name on it. Nothing takes a part any other way, and nothing can go wrong.
bloodandbones.jei.surgery.2: The surgeon hacks: what it takes off leaves a ragged stump, and fitting anything but a crude prosthetic there later takes blood as well (from buckets and a Fluid Backtank you carry, added together): a bucket after a fit surgeon (a villager's or a pillager's head), two or three after a poorer one. The screen shows the price before the cut. Swap an implant straight in for a part of flesh and there is no stump at all.
bloodandbones.jei.surgery.3: A missing arm means no off-hand and slower swings, a missing leg no sprinting, a missing eye less to see by. Lay an implant or a part on the table and lie down again to fit it; an implant unclips with nothing on the table. Fitting never needs a surgeon, and a crude prosthetic never needs blood, so one can always go on.

bloodandbones.ponder.beheader.text_1: The Beheader takes heads off as they come, one quick stroke each, under a line of hanging carcasses too. Zombies, skeletons, creepers and piglins sometimes leave their skull whole
bloodandbones.ponder.beheader.text_2: It is driven by a shaft from below. The faster it turns, the faster it works
bloodandbones.ponder.beheader.text_3: It works any carcass lying on it or hanging over it. Set it flush in a floor so a body lies across it
bloodandbones.ponder.beheader.text_4: What it makes waits inside. Take it with an empty hand, or pull it out with a funnel or hopper
bloodandbones.ponder.beheader.text_5: The filter on its top edge picks which parts it takes: an Attribute Filter set to a part, such as a hind leg, or a spawn egg for one kind of mob
bloodandbones.ponder.bleeding_rack.heade: Draining Blood with the Bleeding Rack
bloodandbones.ponder.bleeding_rack.text_: The Bleeding Rack is a drip tray with a tank for catching blood
Hang a carcass on a Shackle Hook up to 8 blocks above it, and its blood drips into the tray
An Encased Fan blowing across the body drains it up to four times faster
Pipes can pull the blood from the rack's sides and bottom. When the rack is full, the carcass stops draining
bloodandbones.ponder.butcher_hook.header: Hanging Meat on the Butcher's Hook
bloodandbones.ponder.butcher_hook.text_1: Bloody Casing: fill an Andesite Casing with 250 mB of blood from a Spout. It joins up like any casing
bloodandbones.ponder.butcher_hook.text_2: A Butcher's Hook goes on the side of a solid block
bloodandbones.ponder.butcher_hook.text_3: Right-click with any body part to hang it up: a carcass piece, a severed limb, an organ, scraps or meat. A carcass piece keeps there, like a piece in a Specimen Jar
bloodandbones.ponder.butcher_hook.text_4: Take it down with an empty hand. If the block behind it is broken, the hook falls and drops the piece
bloodandbones.ponder.butcher_table.heade: Chopping Pieces on the Butcher's Table
bloodandbones.ponder.butcher_table.text_: Right-click the Butcher's Table with a carcass piece to lay it on the top
Chop it with a Cleaver: it comes apart into meat, bone, offal and fat, spoiled as far as it had rotted. By hand you get about half
A Deployer holding a Cleaver chops too, and gets all of it. A funnel or hopper can lay the pieces on the table
The filter on the edge of its top picks which pieces it takes. A body too heavy to carry can be dragged onto it and chopped where it lies
bloodandbones.ponder.deglover.text_1: The Deglover rolls the hide off a carcass whole, and a sheep's wool with it. It costs a lot of stress: turn it slowly
bloodandbones.ponder.deglover.text_2: It is driven by a shaft from below. Up to 32 RPM, the faster it turns, the faster it works; past that it works no faster
bloodandbones.ponder.deglover.text_3: It works any carcass lying on it or hanging over it. Set it flush in a floor so a body lies across it
bloodandbones.ponder.deglover.text_4: What it makes waits inside. Take it with an empty hand, or pull it out with a funnel or hopper
bloodandbones.ponder.deglover.text_5: The filter on its top edge picks which parts it takes: an Attribute Filter set to a part, such as a hind leg, or a spawn egg for one kind of mob
bloodandbones.ponder.guillotine.header: Taking Limbs Off with the Guillotine
bloodandbones.ponder.guillotine.text_1: The Guillotine winds its blade up while it turns. A redstone pulse drops it through one limb, whole. It never takes the head
bloodandbones.ponder.guillotine.text_2: It is driven by a shaft from below. The faster it turns, the faster it winds its blade up
bloodandbones.ponder.guillotine.text_3: Wound up, it holds the blade at the top, armed. Only a redstone pulse drops it: a lever, a button or a clock beside it
bloodandbones.ponder.guillotine.text_4: It works any carcass lying on it or hanging over it. Set it flush in a floor so a body lies across it
bloodandbones.ponder.guillotine.text_5: What it makes waits inside. Take it with an empty hand, or pull it out with a funnel or hopper
bloodandbones.ponder.guillotine.text_6: The filter on its top edge picks which parts it takes: an Attribute Filter set to a part, such as a hind leg, or a spawn egg for one kind of mob
bloodandbones.ponder.mangler.text_1: The Mangler tears each limb off a carcass and grinds it at once, then the body: the quickest way through a carcass. It keeps the least meat and bone, but gives armour scraps and the mob's own drops
bloodandbones.ponder.mangler.text_2: It is driven by a shaft from below. The faster it turns, the faster it works
bloodandbones.ponder.mangler.text_3: It works any carcass lying on it or hanging over it. Set it flush in a floor so a body lies across it
bloodandbones.ponder.mangler.text_4: What it makes waits inside. Take it with an empty hand, or pull it out with a funnel or hopper
bloodandbones.ponder.mangler.text_5: The filter on its top edge picks which parts it takes: an Attribute Filter set to a part, such as a hind leg, or a spawn egg for one kind of mob
bloodandbones.ponder.spit_roast.text_1: Set the Spit Roast over heat: a campfire, fire, lava or a Blaze Burner
bloodandbones.ponder.spit_roast.text_2: A shaft turns the spit, or a Hand Crank, slowly. It only roasts while it turns, and a fast shaft roasts up to eight times as fast
bloodandbones.ponder.spit_roast.text_3: Right-click with a carcass piece to skewer it. It browns as it cooks
bloodandbones.ponder.spit_roast.text_4: Take it off with an empty hand once cooked: it comes apart into cooked meat and bones. Leave it too long and it burns
bloodandbones.ponder.spit_roast.text_5: A whole carcass goes on too: right-click the spit with the Meat Hook while dragging one. It takes longer, and gives all its meat cooked

bloodless.block.bloodandbones.blood_trou: A trough of _essence_ for essence constructs: they walk to the nearest one they can reach and drink when they run low.
bloodless.block.bloodandbones.ribcage_ar: A segment of _giant rib_, bleached clean. Stacked, ribs rise straight; the top one _bends in_; ribs hung in the air beside it run level, the _crown_ of the arch.
bloodless.block.bloodandbones.surgery_ta: R-Click with a _Cleaver_ to take its _cores_ out, one a cut: a body's pump, bellows, hopper and the _special core_ its mob has, a head's lenses. With nothing laid on it, the Cleaver works on a _body lying over it_ that is too heavy to carry.
bloodless.bloodandbones.jei.backtank.3: Crafted with a plated chestplate, it straps onto the chestplate's back, fluid and all: worn, it is your tank, and the chestplate has the better armour of the two. Craft the chestplate alone to take the tank off again.
bloodless.bloodandbones.jei.carcass_armo: Plated armour is made of salvage from the Mangler. Five pieces of head salvage from one mob make a helmet, four of leg salvage boots. A chestplate is six of torso salvage with two of arm salvage from any one mob on top (the shoulders); leggings are four of leg salvage with three of tail salvage from any one mob, or more legs, on top (the hips). A mob with no bone of a kind uses its torso salvage there.

Craft a piece with one thing to fit it: coverings of one mob (one for a helmet or boots, two for leggings, three for a chestplate) for its covering traits; a core taken out of a mob on the Surgery Table (a pump, lenses, a lucky charm: each says which pieces take it, lenses a helmet, a pump a chestplate) for its core traits. What it replaces comes back.

Tiers, in order: an Essence Steel Ingot, then an Essence Diamond, then a Soul Netherite Ingot, each giving more armour, toughness and durability than the last. Mechanical Crafters fit coverings, cores and tiers too, but only where nothing comes back out.
bloodless.bloodandbones.jei.gland.1: Every mob has a special core, some several: a creeper's powder core, a cow's fermenter, a blaze's core, a skeleton's lean core. Lay a part on a Surgery Table with its Surgical Rig and R-Click with a Cleaver: out come its cores, one a click, each named for its mob. A body too heavy to carry gives them up lying over the table. Some bring more with them (a powder core spills gunpowder).
bloodless.bloodandbones.jei.gland.2: Install one into a piece of plated armour in a crafting grid (each says which pieces take it), or into a construct on the Assembly Frame. What it does there comes from its mob: the Parts and Cores page of each mob lists them.
bloodless.bloodandbones.jei.implants.1: Basic prosthetics (Peg Leg, Hook Hand) need nothing. Plated ones (Plated Arm, Cabled Leg, Furnace Hopper) run on essence and cybernetics (Hydraulic Arm, Piston Leg, Optic Eye, Pump Heart, Bellows Lungs) on soul essence, from a worn Fluid Backtank, a mB or two a second. The Vent Arm runs on whatever the tank holds; the Port Arm needs nothing.
bloodless.bloodandbones.jei.surgery.1: Replacement is a procedure: lay a Cleaver on the Surgery Table (with its Surgical Rig), have a construct with a hand awake beside it and set to Surgeon, and lie on the table (right-click with an empty hand) to have one of your own limbs, eyes or organs removed. You get it back, with your name on it. Nothing removes a part any other way, and nothing can go wrong.
bloodless.bloodandbones.jei.surgery.2: The surgeon works roughly: what it removes leaves an open socket, and fitting anything but a crude prosthetic there later takes essence as well (from buckets and a Fluid Backtank you carry, added together): a bucket after a fit surgeon (a villager's or a pillager's head), two or three after a poorer one. The screen shows the price first. Swap an implant straight in for a part and there is no open socket at all.
bloodless.bloodandbones.jei.surgery.3: A missing arm means no off-hand and slower swings, a missing leg no sprinting, a missing eye less to see by. Lay an implant or a part on the table and lie down again to fit it; an implant unclips with nothing on the table. Fitting never needs a surgeon, and a crude prosthetic never needs essence, so one can always go on.

bloodless.item.bloodandbones.eye.tooltip: Goes back in where a lens is _missing_. A lens gone closes in your _view_; with none you see only a few blocks.
bloodless.item.bloodandbones.flesh_arm.t: Every swing _wears_ it a little. Essence in your backtank clears the wear as you go; fully worn, it gives no bonus until it has been _flushed_.
A _plated_ arm of panels and cable, riveted on. Runs on _essence_ from a worn Fluid Backtank.
bloodless.item.bloodandbones.furnace_sto: Every meal wears it a little. Essence in your backtank clears the wear as you go.
A _plated_ hopper with a fire in it. Runs on _essence_.
bloodless.item.bloodandbones.gland.toolt: Craft it with a piece of _plated armour_ it fits (it says which) to add its mob's _core traits_. A new core replaces the old, which comes back.
R-Click a construct being built on the _Assembly Frame_ with it: its _one special_. A new one replaces the old, which comes back.
A special _core_ taken out of a mob on the Surgery Table: a cell, a filter, a press, a tank. Each mob has its own, and what it does comes from that mob.
bloodless.item.bloodandbones.heart.toolt: _Swaps_ in for a pump. A pump is never taken out alone; one that stops (a dry Pump Heart) leaves you _weak and slow_, but alive.
bloodless.item.bloodandbones.lungs.toolt: Go back in where bellows are _missing_. Without working bellows you cannot sprint.
bloodless.item.bloodandbones.scraps.name: %s %s Salvage
bloodless.item.bloodandbones.scraps.tool: Salvage of one mob makes _plated armour_: head salvage a helmet, torso salvage a chestplate, leg salvage leggings and boots. The mob decides the armour's material and its _traits_.
bloodless.item.bloodandbones.severed_arm: Goes back on where an arm is _missing_, anyone's, either side. It works again.
bloodless.item.bloodandbones.severed_leg: Goes back on where a leg is _missing_, anyone's, either side. It works again.
bloodless.item.bloodandbones.sinew_leg.t: Every stretch you _run_ wears it a little. Essence in your backtank clears the wear as you go; fully worn, it gives no bonus.
A _plated_ leg, all cable. Runs on _essence_ from a worn Fluid Backtank.
bloodless.item.bloodandbones.stomach.too: Goes back in where a hopper is _missing_. Without a working hopper you cannot eat, though you never starve.
bloodless.item.bloodandbones.surgical_ri: Fits it (swapping out any other attachment). Then patients can lie on the table, and a wreck laid on it gives up its _cores_ to a Cleaver, then its _covering_, limbs and meat, one slow cut at a time. By hand the meat and covering come out as a hand's do, about half; a _Deployer_ with a Cleaver gets all of it.
bloodless.trait.bloodandbones.bleeding.d: Your blows spring leaks that last 3 seconds a level.
bloodless.trait.bloodandbones.blood_scen: You sense anything below half its health within 16 blocks, through walls, and see it spark.
bloodless.trait.bloodandbones.echo_sense: Every 5 seconds a sharp click shows you the creatures within 16 blocks (24 at II), through walls. A minion hunts by it through walls.
Dispenses an egg: a minion into what it carries every 5 minutes, for 10 mB of essence; armour into your pack every 10 minutes.
bloodless.trait.bloodandbones.glow_gland: A minion presses out a glow ink sac every 10 minutes, for 15 mB of essence.
bloodless.trait.bloodandbones.honey_stom: A minion dispenses honey into a glass bottle it carries every minute, for 20 mB of essence. Use a glass bottle on it to have honey there and then, for the same. Each minute it also grows a crop within 4 blocks, as a bee does.
A minion presses out an ink sac every 10 minutes, for 15 mB of essence.
bloodless.trait.bloodandbones.mauler.des: Your blows tear: 1 more damage, and the breach leaks for 3 seconds.
bloodless.trait.bloodandbones.roar.desc: Core Ability: a grinding roar that throws everything within 4 blocks back and slows it. Every 20 seconds.
gamerule.bloodandbonesBloodless.descript: Hides blood, gore and wet textures for every player, whatever their own setting. Carcasses and machines work the same.
item.bloodandbones.analytical_lens.toolt: Counts as Create's _goggles_. Looking at a machine _through walls_, you read its speed, its network's stress and what goggles would tell you. Costs a little soul blood, all the time.
An _eye module_: a ground lens with a brass iris.
item.bloodandbones.assembly_frame.toolti: Fits it (swapping out any other attachment). Then a carcass _torso_ laid on it can be built into a minion, with the heads, legs and arms of _any_ mob.
An empty hand takes it back off.

A _leg module_: a pressure vent in the heel.
item.bloodandbones.bellows_lungs.tooltip: You breathe _underwater_. Dry, you are too winded to sprint.
_Cybernetic_ lungs, a pair of bellows. Run on _soul blood_.
item.bloodandbones.blood_diamond.tooltip: Put a diamond through a _Spout_ of _1000 mB_ of blood, then a Spout of _1000 mB_ of Enchantment Industry's liquid experience. Any mod's blood will do.
A diamond steeped in _blood_ and _experience_, one after the other, as a sequenced assembly.
item.bloodandbones.blood_diamond_fluid_b: Sets it _down_, fluid and all. Pipes fill or empty it from any side; break it to pick it up again.

item.bloodandbones.blood_steel_cleaver.t: Takes a limb off, or butchers a piece, in _two_ chops instead of three.
A cleaver of _blood steel_. Every chop goes _twice as deep_.
item.bloodandbones.blood_steel_fluid_bac: Sets it _down_, fluid and all. Pipes fill or empty it from any side; break it to pick it up again.
A _Spout_ fills it and an _Item Drain_ empties it. Organic prosthetics will run on the _blood_ in it, cybernetics on _soul blood_.
A tank for _any fluid_, worn on the back in the chest slot. Holds _8 buckets_ and gives the armour of blood steel.
item.bloodandbones.blood_steel_ingot.too: Iron _quenched in blood_. Fill an iron ingot with _250 mB_ of blood in a Spout.
item.bloodandbones.brass_sheathing.toolt: Sheathes it. Then a _Soul Canister_ wakes it as a brass minion: slower to drain, immune to poison and drowning, but it never heals itself (a _brass sheet_ mends it, from a hand or a _Deployer_). Its maker crouch-R-Clicks it with a _Filter_ (or any item) to limit what it picks up, reaps or goes for; a crouching _Wrench_ takes the filter out.
When R-Clicked on a Brass Frame
Brass plates for a frame of _skinned_ carcass pieces on the Surgery Table.
item.bloodandbones.carcass_boots.tooltip: Every mob's parts do something different: _mix_ them freely. A full set from _one_ mob adds that mob's bonus, and its drawback.
Craft it with _hides of one mob_ (one for a helmet or boots, two for leggings, three for a chestplate) to add that mob's _hide traits_. A new hide replaces the old, which comes back.

Craft it with an organ taken out of a mob on the Surgery Table, such as a _rabbit's foot_ or a goat's _leap gland_, to add that mob's _organ traits_ (each organ says which pieces take it). One organ a piece; a new one replaces the old, which comes back.
Craft it with a _Blood Steel Ingot_, then a _Blood Diamond_, then a _Soul Netherite Ingot_: each tier gives more armour, toughness and durability than the last. Soul netherite does not burn.
Armour of _scraps_ from the Mangler. Its _material_ comes from the family of the mob it was made of, its _traits_ from that mob's parts.
item.bloodandbones.carcass_chestplate.to: Every mob's parts do something different: _mix_ them freely. A full set from _one_ mob adds that mob's bonus, and its drawback.
Craft it with _hides of one mob_ (one for a helmet or boots, two for leggings, three for a chestplate) to add that mob's _hide traits_. A new hide replaces the old, which comes back.

Craft it with an organ taken out of a mob on the Surgery Table, such as a _heart_, _lungs_ or a creeper's _powder sac_, to add that mob's _organ traits_ (each organ says which pieces take it). One organ a piece; a new one replaces the old, which comes back.
Craft it with a _Blood Steel Ingot_, then a _Blood Diamond_, then a _Soul Netherite Ingot_: each tier gives more armour, toughness and durability than the last. Soul netherite does not burn.

Craft it with a _Fluid Backtank_ to strap the tank on its back: prosthetics run on it as if it were worn, Spouts and Item Drains fill and empty it, and the armour is the better of the two. Craft the chestplate alone to take the tank off; if the chestplate breaks or burns, the tank falls free.
Armour of _scraps_ from the Mangler. Its _material_ comes from the family of the mob it was made of, its _traits_ from that mob's parts.
item.bloodandbones.carcass_helmet.toolti: Every mob's parts do something different: _mix_ them freely. A full set from _one_ mob adds that mob's bonus, and its drawback.
Craft it with _hides of one mob_ (one for a helmet or boots, two for leggings, three for a chestplate) to add that mob's _hide traits_. A new hide replaces the old, which comes back.

Craft it with an organ taken out of a mob on the Surgery Table, such as an _eye_ or an _olfactory bulb_, to add that mob's _organ traits_ (each organ says which pieces take it). One organ a piece; a new one replaces the old, which comes back.
Craft it with a _Blood Steel Ingot_, then a _Blood Diamond_, then a _Soul Netherite Ingot_: each tier gives more armour, toughness and durability than the last. Soul netherite does not burn.
Armour of _scraps_ from the Mangler. Its _material_ comes from the family of the mob it was made of, its _traits_ from that mob's parts.

Craft it with _hides of one mob_ (one for a helmet or boots, two for leggings, three for a chestplate) to add that mob's _hide traits_. A new hide replaces the old, which comes back.

Craft it with an organ taken out of a mob on the Surgery Table, such as a _stomach_ or a spider's _spinneret_, to add that mob's _organ traits_ (each organ says which pieces take it). One organ a piece; a new one replaces the old, which comes back.
Craft it with a _Blood Steel Ingot_, then a _Blood Diamond_, then a _Soul Netherite Ingot_: each tier gives more armour, toughness and durability than the last. Soul netherite does not burn.
Armour of _scraps_ from the Mangler. Its _material_ comes from the family of the mob it was made of, its _traits_ from that mob's parts.
item.bloodandbones.carcass_piece.tooltip: Picks a _loose_ piece up off the ground. Pieces still attached have to be cut off first.
Puts it back down as a _body_ again.
It can be _roasted_, or kept on _show_.
When Shift-R-Clicked with an Empty Hand
On a Spit Roast or in a Specimen Jar
A piece of carcass light enough to _carry_: a head, a leg, or a whole small animal.
item.bloodandbones.cleaver.tooltip.behav: _Cuts_ into the joint. Three cuts and the limb comes off as a piece of its own.
_Butchers_ it: three cuts and it falls apart into meat, bone and, from the body, offal and fat.
item.bloodandbones.cleaver.tooltip.condi: When R-Clicked on a Loose Piece
item.bloodandbones.cleaver.tooltip.summa: A heavy blade for taking a carcass _apart_. Slow in a fight, but it goes through bone.
item.bloodandbones.congealed_blood.toolt: A Diesel Generators _Basin Lid_ on a Basin of blood sets _250 mB_ of it into one.
_Haunt_ it: an _Encased Fan_ blowing through _soul fire_ turns it into a Soul Clot.
Blood left to _set_ under a lid: a dark, wobbling slab. The first step of the _soul blood_ line.
item.bloodandbones.copper_fluid_backtank: Sets it _down_, fluid and all. Pipes fill or empty it from any side; break it to pick it up again.
A _Spout_ fills it and an _Item Drain_ empties it. Organic prosthetics will run on the _blood_ in it, cybernetics on _soul blood_.
A tank for _any fluid_, worn on the back in the chest slot. Holds _2 buckets_ and gives the armour of copper.
item.bloodandbones.crude_heart.tooltip.b: It beats like your own. A heart is only ever _swapped_, never taken out, so keep one of these by the table.
item.bloodandbones.crude_heart.tooltip.s: A _crude prosthetic_ heart: a leather pump on an iron frame. Needs nothing to run.
item.bloodandbones.crude_lungs.tooltip.b: You breathe, and _sprint_, as you did.
item.bloodandbones.crude_lungs.tooltip.s: _Crude prosthetic_ lungs: two leather bags on a bone frame. Need nothing to run.
item.bloodandbones.crude_stomach.tooltip: A _crude prosthetic_ stomach: a leather sack in an iron cage. Needs nothing to run.
item.bloodandbones.diamond_fluid_backtan: Sets it _down_, fluid and all. Pipes fill or empty it from any side; break it to pick it up again.
A _Spout_ fills it and an _Item Drain_ empties it. Organic prosthetics will run on the _blood_ in it, cybernetics on _soul blood_.
A tank for _any fluid_, worn on the back in the chest slot. Holds _6 buckets_ and gives the armour of diamond.
item.bloodandbones.dormant_minion.toolti: Sets it down there, still out of blood. Give it _blood_ to wake it.
A minion that ran out of blood, _folded up_ to carry. It keeps everything: what it is built of, its task, what it carries.
item.bloodandbones.empty_soul_canister.t: A _Spout_ fills it with a bucket's worth of soul blood; an _Item Drain_ empties it again.
A brass canister with a glass window, for _soul blood_ to animate a _brass minion_.
item.bloodandbones.eye.tooltip.behaviour: Goes back in where an eye is _missing_. An eye gone closes in your _view_; with none you see only a few blocks.
item.bloodandbones.flensing_knife.toolti: _Skins_ it: four strokes take the whole hide off, and a sheep's wool with it. The carcass shows _bare meat_ afterwards.
Skin _first_: a piece butchered with its hide on loses the hide. A rotting hide is poorer; a rotten one is gone.
A curved knife for taking the _hide_ off in one piece.
item.bloodandbones.flesh_arm.tooltip.beh: Blocks break _30%_ faster and it hits _harder_. When the tank runs dry it hangs _dead_, as good as no arm.
Every swing _rots_ it a little. Blood in your backtank clears the rot as you go; fully rotted, it gives no bonus until it has been _perfused_.
item.bloodandbones.flesh_arm.tooltip.sum: An _organic_ arm of meat and sinew, stitched on. Runs on _blood_ from a worn Fluid Backtank.
item.bloodandbones.furnace_stomach.toolt: Nothing you eat makes you _sick_: no hunger, no poison. Dry, you cannot eat (but you do not starve).
Every meal rots it a little. Blood in your backtank clears the rot as you go.
An _organic_ stomach with a fire in it. Runs on _blood_.
item.bloodandbones.gland.tooltip.behavio: Craft it with a piece of _carcass armour_ it fits (it says which) to add its mob's _organ traits_. A new organ replaces the old, which comes back.
R-Click a minion being built on the _Assembly Frame_ with it: its _one special_. A new one replaces the old, which comes back.
item.bloodandbones.gland.tooltip.summary: A special _organ_ cut out of a mob on the Surgery Table: a sac, a gland, a bulb, a core. Each mob has its own, and what it does comes from that mob.
item.bloodandbones.glass_eye.tooltip.beh: You _see_ as you did. Nothing more.
item.bloodandbones.glass_eye.tooltip.sum: A _crude prosthetic_ eye of glass and iron. Needs nothing to run.
item.bloodandbones.gold_fluid_backtank.t: Sets it _down_, fluid and all. Pipes fill or empty it from any side; break it to pick it up again.
A _Spout_ fills it and an _Item Drain_ empties it. Organic prosthetics will run on the _blood_ in it, cybernetics on _soul blood_.
A tank for _any fluid_, worn on the back in the chest slot. Holds _3 buckets_ and gives the armour of gold.
item.bloodandbones.grappling_spool.toolt: Fires the hook where you look, further the longer you spooled. A _light_ thing is reeled in to you; anything _heavy_ (a wall, a big mob, a heavy carcass) reels _you_ in to it. Choose what you hook: a wall at speed hurts.
An _arm module_: a barbed hook on a reel of cable.
item.bloodandbones.gyroscopic_stabilizer: Takes _no fall damage_, paying soul blood for every block fallen past the safe distance. What the tank cannot pay for, you take: check your gauge before you step off.
A _leg module_: a spinning gyroscope in the shin.
item.bloodandbones.heart.tooltip.behavio: _Swaps_ in for a heart. A heart is never taken out alone; one that stops (a dry Pump Heart) leaves you _weak and slow_, but alive.
item.bloodandbones.hook_hand.tooltip.beh: The arm works as it did: the _off-hand_ and full-speed swings come back. Nothing more.
item.bloodandbones.hook_hand.tooltip.sum: A _crude prosthetic_ arm: an iron hook on a leather cuff. Needs nothing to run.
item.bloodandbones.hydraulic_arm.tooltip: Blocks break _80%_ faster, it hits _much_ harder, and it reaches a block further. Dry, it stops.
Takes _2 arm modules_, fitted at a Surgery Table with no cutting: lay the module on the table.
A _cybernetic_ arm of brass and blood steel. Runs on _soul blood_ from a worn Fluid Backtank.
item.bloodandbones.iron_fluid_backtank.t: Sets it _down_, fluid and all. Pipes fill or empty it from any side; break it to pick it up again.
A _Spout_ fills it and an _Item Drain_ empties it. Organic prosthetics will run on the _blood_ in it, cybernetics on _soul blood_.
A tank for _any fluid_, worn on the back in the chest slot. Holds _4 buckets_ and gives the armour of iron.
item.bloodandbones.lungs.tooltip.behavio: Go back in where lungs are _missing_. Without working lungs you cannot sprint.
item.bloodandbones.magnet_coil.tooltip.b: Loose items and experience _drift_ to you from a few blocks.
Pulls from further the longer it is held. Near the top it takes hold of _carcasses_ too.
item.bloodandbones.magnet_coil.tooltip.s: An _arm module_: a coil of copper round the forearm.
item.bloodandbones.meat_hook.tooltip.beh: _Hooks_ the limb you clicked and _drags_ the body behind you. Heavier animals slow you more. R-Click again to let go.
Hangs the carcass you are dragging _by the neck_.
Hangs the carcass you are dragging on a _trolley_ that rides the chain.
item.bloodandbones.meat_hook.tooltip.con: When R-Clicked on a Shackle Hook
When R-Clicked on a Chain Conveyor
item.bloodandbones.meat_hook.tooltip.sum: The butcher's first tool. Anything _killed_ with it is left behind as a whole _physics carcass_ instead of dropping loot.
item.bloodandbones.optic_eye.tooltip.beh: You see in the _dark_. Dry, it sees nothing.
Takes _1 eye module_, fitted at a Surgery Table with no cutting: lay the module on the table.
item.bloodandbones.optic_eye.tooltip.sum: A _cybernetic_ eye with a red lens. Runs on _soul blood_.
item.bloodandbones.peg_leg.tooltip.behav: The leg works as it did: you can _sprint_ again. Nothing more.
item.bloodandbones.peg_leg.tooltip.summa: A _crude prosthetic_ leg of iron, leather and bone. Needs nothing to run.
item.bloodandbones.piston_leg.tooltip.be: Walks faster, jumps _far_ higher and lands soft. Dry, it stops.
Takes _2 leg modules_, fitted at a Surgery Table with no cutting: lay the module on the table.
item.bloodandbones.piston_leg.tooltip.su: A _cybernetic_ leg on a piston. Runs on _soul blood_ from a worn Fluid Backtank.
item.bloodandbones.piston_ram.tooltip.be: Strikes what you look at with _knockback_ that grows with the spool. Looking down at the ground, it _launches_ you instead. Pair it with a _Gyroscopic Stabilizer_ for the landing.
item.bloodandbones.piston_ram.tooltip.su: An _arm module_: a piston behind the knuckles.
item.bloodandbones.port_arm.tooltip.beha: Plugs your worn tank into the _pipes_: pump into the port to fill it, out of it to empty it.
item.bloodandbones.port_arm.tooltip.cond: Crouching Next to a Backtank Port
item.bloodandbones.port_arm.tooltip.summ: A _cybernetic_ arm with a pipe coupling for a hand. Needs nothing to run.
item.bloodandbones.pump_heart.tooltip.be: It keeps _healing_ you. Dry, it barely beats: you are _weak and slow_ until it has soul blood again.
item.bloodandbones.pump_heart.tooltip.su: A _cybernetic_ heart, a brass pump. Runs on _soul blood_.
item.bloodandbones.rotational_coupler.to: Look at the end of a machine's shaft and the shaft reaches out and _drives_ it: 16 RPM on a tap, up to 256 RPM at full spool, with stress capacity to match. Let go and it pulls back.
An _arm module_: a telescoping shaft in the forearm.
item.bloodandbones.scraps.tooltip.behavi: Scraps of one mob make _carcass armour_: head scraps a helmet, torso scraps a chestplate, leg scraps leggings and boots. The mob decides the armour's material and its _traits_.
item.bloodandbones.scraps.tooltip.summar: What the _Mangler_ grinds a piece of carcass into, keeping which _mob_ and which _part_ it was.
item.bloodandbones.severed_arm.tooltip.b: Goes back on where an arm is _missing_, anyone's, either side. It is flesh again.
item.bloodandbones.severed_arm.tooltip.s: Somebody's _arm_, taken off on a Surgery Table.
item.bloodandbones.severed_leg.tooltip.b: Goes back on where a leg is _missing_, anyone's, either side. It is flesh again.
item.bloodandbones.severed_leg.tooltip.s: Somebody's _leg_, taken off on a Surgery Table.
item.bloodandbones.sinew_leg.tooltip.beh: Walks a little faster and jumps _higher_. When the tank runs dry it is _dead weight_.
Every stretch you _run_ rots it a little. Blood in your backtank clears the rot as you go; fully rotted, it gives no bonus.
item.bloodandbones.sinew_leg.tooltip.sum: An _organic_ leg, all muscle. Runs on _blood_ from a worn Fluid Backtank.
item.bloodandbones.soul_canister.tooltip: Swaps into it, and the empty comes back. On the Surgery Table it wakes a sheathed brass frame.
When Used on a Brass Minion
A canister of _soul blood_: a brass minion's power.
item.bloodandbones.soul_clot.tooltip.beh: Blow an _Encased Fan_ through _soul fire_ over Congealed Blood.
A _Mechanical Mixer_ over a _superheated_ Basin melts it back into _200 mB_ of soul blood.
item.bloodandbones.soul_clot.tooltip.sum: Congealed blood with a _soul_ caught in it, faintly glowing.
item.bloodandbones.soul_netherite_fluid_: Sets it _down_, fluid and all. Pipes fill or empty it from any side; break it to pick it up again.
A _Spout_ fills it and an _Item Drain_ empties it. Organic prosthetics will run on the _blood_ in it, cybernetics on _soul blood_.
A tank for _any fluid_, worn on the back in the chest slot. Holds _32 buckets_ and gives the armour of soul netherite.
_Sequenced assembly_: fill a netherite ingot with 1000 mB of soul blood, then press a _super experience block_ into it with a Deployer.
item.bloodandbones.stomach.tooltip.behav: Goes back in where a stomach is _missing_. Without a working stomach you cannot eat, though you never starve.
Fits it (swapping out any other attachment). Then patients can lie on the table, and a carcass laid on it gives up its _organs_ to a Cleaver, then its _hide_, limbs and meat, one slow cut at a time. By hand the meat and hide come out as a hand's do, about half; a _Deployer_ with a Cleaver gets all of it.
An empty hand takes it back off.
When R-Clicked on a Surgery Table
When Sneak-R-Clicked off an Empty Table
A Surgery Table _attachment_: an overhead arm of lamps, clamps and blades. Makes the table a place to _operate_.
item.bloodandbones.vent_arm.tooltip.beha: Sprays the tank ahead of you: _lava_ or fuel burns, _water_ puts fires out, _liquid experience_ gives experience, _milk_ clears effects, anything else spills.
item.bloodandbones.vent_arm.tooltip.cond: When Use Is Held with an Empty Hand
item.bloodandbones.vent_arm.tooltip.summ: A _cybernetic_ arm that ends in a nozzle. Runs on _whatever is in the tank_, and sprays it.
itemGroup.bloodandbones.title: Create: Blood & Bones
trait.bloodandbones.adrenaline.desc: Hurt below 40% health: Strength and Speed for 6 seconds. Once a minute.
trait.bloodandbones.bamboo_gut.desc: Bamboo and sugar cane are food: use them while hungry. A minion eats them for 25 mB of blood each, until it is half full.
trait.bloodandbones.barbed.desc: Whatever hits you up close takes 1 damage a level from your spikes.
trait.bloodandbones.beast_of_burden.desc: A minion drags carcasses more easily, and its maker can fit it with a chest (use one on it) for 18 more slots.
trait.bloodandbones.beloved.desc: Golems trust you and come to your defence: whatever hurts you within 16 blocks, or any monster you fight, they go for.
trait.bloodandbones.blast.desc: Ability, below half health: a blast around you that spares you. 50 mB of blood, every minute.
trait.bloodandbones.bleeding.desc: Your blows open wounds that bleed for 3 seconds a level.
trait.bloodandbones.blink.desc: When hurt, an even chance to blink up to 16 blocks away.
trait.bloodandbones.blood_scent.desc: You smell out anything below half its health within 16 blocks, through walls, and see it drip.
trait.bloodandbones.bouncy.desc: Bounce back up from a long fall instead of taking damage. Crouch to land flat.
trait.bloodandbones.bowman.desc: A minion's arms loose arrows at what it fights, keeping their distance, a drop of blood a shot.
trait.bloodandbones.cat_terror.desc: Within 8 blocks of a cat or an ocelot you cower: Slowness II and Weakness.
trait.bloodandbones.charge.desc: Ability: lunge forward, throwing aside everything around you. Every 10 seconds.
trait.bloodandbones.cleanse.desc: Ability: clears every harmful effect on you. 50 mB of blood.
trait.bloodandbones.creeper_kin.desc: Creepers take you for one of their own and leave you be. One you hurt fights back for 30 seconds.
trait.bloodandbones.curable.desc: Weakness never takes hold of you, and a golden apple gives you Absorption II.
trait.bloodandbones.dark_mend.desc: A minion in the dark knits back 1 health every 10 seconds, for 5 mB of blood (brass never heals itself).
trait.bloodandbones.dash.desc: Ability: dash forward along the ground. 20 mB of blood, every 5 seconds.
trait.bloodandbones.dead_face.desc: Zombies take you for one of their own and leave you be. One you hurt fights back for 30 seconds.
trait.bloodandbones.deflector.desc: A chance to send projectiles back the way they came: a quarter a level.
trait.bloodandbones.displacer.desc: Now and then a blow blinks what you hit off somewhere within 8 blocks.
trait.bloodandbones.dry_out.desc: After a minute out of water: Slowness, and 2 armour less.
trait.bloodandbones.echo_sense.desc: Every 5 seconds a wet click shows you the creatures within 16 blocks (24 at II), through walls. A minion hunts by it through walls.
trait.bloodandbones.egg_layer.desc: Lays an egg: a minion into what it carries every 5 minutes, for 10 mB of blood; armour into your pack every 10 minutes.
trait.bloodandbones.eight_eyes.desc: In the dark, hostile mobs within 8 blocks show through walls.
trait.bloodandbones.elder_curse.desc: Whatever strikes you up close gets Mining Fatigue II for 6 seconds.
trait.bloodandbones.ember_skin.desc: Whatever hits you up close burns for 2 seconds.
trait.bloodandbones.ender_calm.desc: Endermen take no notice of the minion. One it hurts fights back for 30 seconds.
trait.bloodandbones.ender_mask.desc: Endermen do not mind being looked at.
trait.bloodandbones.evasive.desc: A chance to twist aside from a blow: a tenth a level.
trait.bloodandbones.fang_strike.desc: A tenth of your blows call evoker fangs up under what you hit, at most once every 10 seconds.
trait.bloodandbones.fangs.desc: Ability: evoker fangs snap up out of the ground under what you look at.
trait.bloodandbones.fat_reserve.desc: A minion holds a quarter more blood a level.
trait.bloodandbones.fatigue_aura.desc: Once a minute, hostile creatures within 16 blocks get Mining Fatigue II.
trait.bloodandbones.fireball.desc: Ability: three small fireballs, where you look.
trait.bloodandbones.flinger.desc: Your blows fling what you hit up into the air, higher each level.
trait.bloodandbones.fly_swat.desc: Whatever hits you from behind is swatted back.
trait.bloodandbones.forager.desc: A minion eats wheat and hay it carries, and grass where it stands (if mobs may trample it), for 100 mB of blood each, until it is half full.
trait.bloodandbones.four_chambers.desc: Plant foods fill you half as much again.
trait.bloodandbones.frost_path.desc: Water freezes under your feet, as with Frost Walker.
trait.bloodandbones.glider.desc: The chestplate spreads like an elytra: glide by jumping in mid-air. Costs hunger, not durability.
trait.bloodandbones.glow_aura.desc: Hostile creatures within 8 blocks glow, for everyone to see.
trait.bloodandbones.glow_gland.desc: A minion squeezes out a glow ink sac every 10 minutes, for 15 mB of blood.
trait.bloodandbones.golem_trust.desc: Iron and snow golems trust you, whatever the villagers say of you. One you hurt fights back for 30 seconds.
trait.bloodandbones.great_fireball.desc: Ability: a ghast's great fireball, bursting where it lands (it breaks blocks only where mobs may, and never a minion's).
trait.bloodandbones.guardian_beam.desc: Ability: a guardian's beam locked on what you look at, burning into it three seconds later.
trait.bloodandbones.heat_hurts.desc: Hot places hurt, 1 damage a second: deserts, badlands, savannas and the Nether.
trait.bloodandbones.hiss.desc: Mobs notice you only half as far off.
trait.bloodandbones.honey.desc: Ability: cures poison and gives Regeneration II for 5 seconds. 30 mB of blood.
trait.bloodandbones.honey_stomach.desc: A minion brings up honey into a glass bottle it carries every minute, for 20 mB of blood. Use a glass bottle on it to have honey there and then, for the same. Each minute it also grows a crop within 4 blocks, as a bee does.
trait.bloodandbones.horde_call.desc: Hurt, and your minions and every zombie within 16 blocks turn on whatever did it.
trait.bloodandbones.hump.desc: A minion holds twice as much blood.
trait.bloodandbones.ink_cloud.desc: Hurt, a minion squirts a cloud of ink that blinds everything within 4 blocks for 3 seconds; worn, it does when you are below half health.
trait.bloodandbones.ink_gland.desc: A minion squeezes out an ink sac every 10 minutes, for 15 mB of blood.
trait.bloodandbones.insulated.desc: Freezing does not hurt you, and you walk on powder snow (worn on carcass boots).
trait.bloodandbones.inverted_healing.des: Healing potions hurt you and harming potions heal you, as with the undead.
trait.bloodandbones.iron_gut.desc: Hunger, rotten flesh and raw meat do you no harm. A minion turns them into blood, 25 mB each: fed by hand, or eaten from what it carries when it runs low.
trait.bloodandbones.item_magnet.desc: Loose items within 5 blocks hop to you (7 at II, 9 at III).
trait.bloodandbones.lanolin.desc: The piece oils itself, mending a point of wear every 30 seconds.
trait.bloodandbones.lava_soak.desc: In lava, fire and lava hurt you half as much.
trait.bloodandbones.lava_wader.desc: Lava crusts over under your feet and melts back behind you; fire hurts you a quarter less.
trait.bloodandbones.lava_walk.desc: A minion walks on lava as a strider does, and fire does not hurt it while it stands on or in lava.
trait.bloodandbones.leaky.desc: A minion goes through half as much blood again.
trait.bloodandbones.lean.desc: Your implants, or a minion's body, go through a tenth less blood a level.
trait.bloodandbones.leap.desc: Ability: spring forward and up. Every 3 seconds.
trait.bloodandbones.loyal.desc: A minion following its maker blinks back to them when it falls more than 24 blocks behind.
trait.bloodandbones.luminous.desc: The piece glows in the dark, as a glow squid does. A minion shines from head to foot.
trait.bloodandbones.marrow.desc: A minion goes through a fifth less blood.
trait.bloodandbones.mauler.desc: Your blows tear: 1 more damage, and the wound bleeds for 3 seconds.
trait.bloodandbones.milk_udder.desc: A minion fills an empty bucket it carries with milk every 5 minutes, for 50 mB of blood. Use an empty bucket on it to milk it there and then, for the same.
trait.bloodandbones.morning_gift.desc: At dawn a minion turns up a gift, as a cat does for its owner, and keeps it.
trait.bloodandbones.mycelial_gut.desc: Mushrooms are food, and mushrooms and stews give Regeneration for 5 seconds. A minion eats mushrooms it carries or stands on for 50 mB of blood each, until it is half full.
trait.bloodandbones.night_swift.desc: At night you move a twentieth faster.
trait.bloodandbones.omnivore.desc: Any food fills you a little longer.
trait.bloodandbones.pack_hunter.desc: 15% more damage for each ally within 8 blocks, up to 3: your minions, your pets and any wolf or fox.
trait.bloodandbones.piglin_kin.desc: Piglins and their brutes take you for one of their own, as if you wore gold. One you hurt fights back for 30 seconds.
trait.bloodandbones.play_dead.desc: Below a quarter health, a hit sets you playing dead: Regeneration II, and hostile creatures within 16 blocks lose you for 5 seconds. Once a minute.
trait.bloodandbones.potion_thrower.desc: A minion keeps its distance and throws the splash potions it carries at its target, or a poison of its own brewing for 5 mB of blood, every 3 seconds.
trait.bloodandbones.pouch.desc: A minion carries 9 more stacks a level.
trait.bloodandbones.powder_walker.desc: Walk on powder snow without sinking (worn on carcass boots).
trait.bloodandbones.purr.desc: Every 10 seconds, your minions and pets within 4 blocks get Regeneration I.
trait.bloodandbones.quench.desc: Once alight, you burn for half as long (a quarter as long at II).
trait.bloodandbones.quick_draw.desc: Draw bows and load crossbows twice as fast.
trait.bloodandbones.raider_kin.desc: Illagers, witches and ravagers take you for one of the raid and leave you be. One you hurt fights back for 30 seconds.
trait.bloodandbones.remedy.desc: Hurt below half health, you drink a remedy: Regeneration for 5 seconds, and Fire Resistance too if you are burning. Once every 30 seconds.
trait.bloodandbones.repair_with_iron.des: An iron ingot used on a minion mends 25 health, flesh or brass.
trait.bloodandbones.rift.desc: When hurt, a 30% chance to blink a few blocks away.
trait.bloodandbones.roar.desc: Organ Ability: a slobbering roar that throws everything within 4 blocks back and slows it. Every 20 seconds.
trait.bloodandbones.roll_up.desc: Hurt below 30% health: curl up tight, Resistance III and Slowness V for 4 seconds.
trait.bloodandbones.scute_shed.desc: A minion sheds an armadillo scute into what it carries every 5 minutes, for 20 mB of blood.
trait.bloodandbones.searing.desc: Your blows set what you hit alight, 2 seconds a level.
trait.bloodandbones.second_wind.desc: Hurt below 30% health: Speed II and Regeneration for 5 seconds. Once a minute.
trait.bloodandbones.seed_eater.desc: Seeds are food: use them while hungry. A minion eats seeds it carries for 25 mB of blood each, until it is half full.
trait.bloodandbones.self_destruct.desc: A minion close to its target hisses and blows up, sparing itself, then lies powered down until it is given blood again.
trait.bloodandbones.shell_lid.desc: A three in ten chance to send back projectiles that come at you from the front, as a shulker's lid does.
trait.bloodandbones.shulker_bolt.desc: Ability: a shulker's homing bolt at what you look at; what it hits floats up.
trait.bloodandbones.silent_steps.desc: Your steps, landings and splashes make no vibrations for sculk or wardens to hear.
trait.bloodandbones.silk_gland.desc: A minion spins string into what it carries every 2 and a half minutes, for 10 mB of blood.
trait.bloodandbones.skeleton_kin.desc: Skeletons take you for one of their own and leave you be. One you hurt fights back for 30 seconds.
trait.bloodandbones.sneeze.desc: A minion with a weak panda's head sneezes every two minutes or so, for 5 mB of blood, and what comes out (slime, mostly) goes in with what it carries.
trait.bloodandbones.snowball_volley.desc: Ability: a spray of snowballs. A minion keeps its distance and pelts what it fights.
trait.bloodandbones.sonic_boom.desc: Ability: a warden's blast of sound, charged for a moment, tearing through armour at what you look at.
trait.bloodandbones.spectral_sight.desc: Invisible creatures within 16 blocks show as outlines, and a minion sees them as plain as day.
trait.bloodandbones.spit.desc: Ability: a gob of spit, where you look.
trait.bloodandbones.stew_udder.desc: A minion fills a bowl it carries with mushroom stew every 5 minutes, for 50 mB of blood. Use a bowl on it to have stew there and then, for the same.
trait.bloodandbones.still_mend.desc: A minion standing still knits back 1 health every 4 seconds, for 5 mB of blood (brass never heals itself).
trait.bloodandbones.stinger.desc: A quarter of your blows sting: Poison II for 3 seconds, at most once every 10 seconds.
trait.bloodandbones.sun_cursed.desc: Catches fire in daylight under open sky unless wet, helmet or no helmet.
trait.bloodandbones.thief.desc: Now and then a blow snatches what a mob holds (never a player's); a minion's bite snatches it every time.
trait.bloodandbones.tongue.desc: Ability: a sticky tongue yanks what you look at, up to 6 blocks off, over to you.
trait.bloodandbones.toss.desc: One blow in seven or so tosses what you hit up into the air, as a hoglin's tusks do.
trait.bloodandbones.totem.desc: A killing blow leaves you on 1 health instead, as a Totem of Undying does, for 500 mB of blood; then not again for 20 minutes. A minion collapses rather than dying.
trait.bloodandbones.toxin_puff.desc: Anything not on your side that comes within 2 blocks is poisoned.
trait.bloodandbones.traders_draught.desc: At night, when a mob sets its sights on you, you drink yourself invisible for 20 seconds. Once every 5 minutes.
trait.bloodandbones.trample.desc: A minion breaks through leaves, grass and flowers in its way (where the server allows minions to break blocks).
trait.bloodandbones.tremor_sense.desc: You feel anything moving within 16 blocks through the ground, through walls. Still or sneaking things go unfelt. A minion hunts by it through walls.
trait.bloodandbones.truffle_nose.desc: A minion has a knack for digging: half again as fit for the Digger task.
trait.bloodandbones.undying.desc: A killing blow leaves you on 1 health instead: a fifth of the time at level I, every time at V; then not again for 5 minutes. A minion collapses rather than dying.
trait.bloodandbones.wall_climber.desc: Cling to walls, sliding slowly down; on two pieces, climb them while holding jump.
trait.bloodandbones.warp.desc: Ability: blink up to 8 blocks where you look. 50 mB of blood, every 6 seconds.
trait.bloodandbones.warped_dread.desc: Within 7 blocks of a warped fungus you shrink back: Slowness and Weakness.
trait.bloodandbones.water_hurts.desc: Water and rain burn: 1 damage a second.
trait.bloodandbones.web_shot.desc: Ability: a flick of silk at what you look at, stinging, leaving it stuck in a web for 5 seconds.
trait.bloodandbones.webbing.desc: A fifth of your blows leave what you hit stuck in a web for 3 seconds.
trait.bloodandbones.wide_eyes.desc: A warning, and which way to look, whenever something within 12 blocks sets its sights on you.
trait.bloodandbones.wind_burst.desc: Ability: a burst of wind throws you high, and you take no fall damage until you land. 40 mB of blood, every 10 seconds.
trait.bloodandbones.wind_shot.desc: A minion keeps its distance and fires wind charges at its target, one every 2 seconds, for 2 mB of blood each.
trait.bloodandbones.wither_aura.desc: Anything not on your side within 4 blocks withers.
trait.bloodandbones.wool_regrowth.desc: A minion grows a fleece in the colour its sheep had (white if it had none) and sheds it into what it carries every 5 minutes, for 20 mB of blood.
